en: The water is shallow here.\nThere are many people swimming.
Splash!
I wish I could ride my POKéMON.\nI bet you're not tired.
SEAFOAM is a quiet getaway.\nI'm vacationing here.
Quit it!
There's a huge cavern underneath\nthis island.
I love floating with the fishes\nhere among the waves.
Yowch!
Want to float with me?
Are you on vacation, too?
No mercy at all!
SEAFOAM used to be a single island\nin the distant past.
Check out my buff physique!
Wimpy!
I should've been buffing up my\nPOKéMON, not me!
Why are you riding a POKéMON?\nCan't you swim?
Ouch!\nTorpedoed!
Riding a POKéMON sure looks fun!
I rode my bird POKéMON here.
Oh, no!\nNow what am I to do?
My birds are exhausted.\nThey can't FLY me back!
My boyfriend gave me big pearls.
Oh, no!\nMy pearls were in them!
Will my pearls grow bigger inside\nCLOYSTER?
I swam here from CINNABAR ISLAND.\nIt wasn't easy, I tell you.
I'm so disappointed!
POKéMON have taken over an\nabandoned mansion on CINNABAR.\pThey call it the POKéMON MANSION\nnow.
CINNABAR, in the west, has a LAB\nfor POKéMON.\pMy daddy works there.
Wait!\nYou're supposed to wait!
CINNABAR is a volcanic island.\pI heard it rose out of the sea\nwhen a volcano erupted.
SEAFOAM ISLANDS
Strong TRAINERS and WATER POKéMON\nare common sights in these parts.\pThey say that MISTY of the\nCERULEAN GYM trains here.
